viewing_check: Check the 3 of the date for alteration (compare with 1928/1925 and 1913-1914 style); look at the reverse for matching wear and colour, weight about 9.6g, and any tooling or filing around the date. A genuine coin is clearly valuable; also check for holes and cleaning.
